scope: One B3 terminal tower plus one explanatory whole-fortification preview. No Field, runtime publisher, canonical layout or formal adoption.

geometry_revision.body: Ten fine staggered stone courses matching A3 scale, narrow joints/chamfers, sparse deterministic chips and shallow front recesses.
geometry_revision.upper: Three real narrow arrow openings, thin lintel and five low crenellations matching A3's gate-wall language.
geometry_revision.unchanged: Actual v1 B draw bounds, minimum-Y support, 1.98m height, BODY_ORIGIN and frozen 30-degree orthographic camera.

group_preview.asset_local_scale: A3 and B3 are 1.0; south_gate uses its existing uniform 0.5208333333333334 explanatory scale. No flip or nonuniform stretch.

license_boundary.rock_01: Existing Poly Haven CC0-1.0 material dependency.
license_boundary.worn_bluestone_and_architecture: Existing project-original texture and procedural project geometry; not CC0 architecture.
